name: dax_never_blank_measure_by_a_dimension_lists_every_member
expect_sql:
SELECT COALESCE(m0.g0, v.region) AS region,
       COALESCE(v.sales0, COALESCE(NULL, 0) + 0) AS sales0
FROM   (
            SELECT DISTINCT j1.region AS g0
            FROM   retail.dim_customer j1
            UNION
            SELECT NULL AS g0
            FROM   retail.fct_sales t
            LEFT JOIN retail.dim_customer j1 ON j1.customer_key = t.customer_key
            WHERE  j1.customer_key IS NULL
        ) m0
FULL JOIN (
    SELECT j1.region,
           COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) + 0 AS sales0
    FROM   retail.fct_sales t
    LEFT JOIN retail.dim_customer j1 ON j1.customer_key = t.customer_key
    GROUP BY j1.region
) v
  ON  m0.g0 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v.region
